digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match reality due to fixes or subsequent work, the completion verifier blocks close without a documented legitimate path forward
Using --force-close or --ref to old commits to work around stale criteria leaves inaccurate records in the ticket system claiming code states that do not hold
The sanctioned remedy is to edit the ticket criteria to match reality, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria, but this path is not documented
The --ref <landing-commit> flag is already a legitimate, auditable escape hatch for criteria invalidated by subsequent work and should be documented as the proper close path for that subclass
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check blocks closing completed, merged work solely because the criteria registry changed, forcing expensive re-review of already-executed plans
